fields.**props**: assetId: UUID, assetTitle: string, canDeletePermanently: boolean, hasActiveObligations: boolean
fields.**fields**: confirmationText: string (must equal asset title), reason: string (required for moderation-triggered removal)
fields.**validation**: Confirmation text must match asset title; reason required for moderation cases
fields.**actions**: Cancel, Archive Instead, Request Permanent Deletion
fields.**states**: idle → validating → submitting → success → error → permissionDenied
fields.**rules**: Creator may archive content; permanent deletion request removes from public immediately; 30-day recovery window; published releases with active royalty obligations cannot be deleted; audit event created
fields.**response**: { status: \"delete_pending\", deletionRequestedAt: string, purgeScheduledAt: string, canRestoreUntil: string }

fields.**props**: payoutId: string, amount: number, recipient: string, requiresSecondApproval: boolean
fields.**fields**: Review payout details; approvalLevel: 1 \| 2 (auto-calculated), notes: string (required for \>\$10k)
fields.**validation**: Level 1 approver cannot be same as Level 2 approver; approver cannot approve own payout
fields.**rules**: Payouts \>\$10k require dual approval; approver cannot approve own payout; audit event created

fields.**trigger**: \"Buy Ticket\" on live stream or event
fields.**purpose**: Purchase access to paid live event
fields.**props**: eventId: string, tiers: TicketTier[], onComplete: (ticket: Ticket) =\> void
fields.**fields**: tierId: select, quantity: number (1-10), paymentMethodId: select
fields.**validation**: Tier must be selected; payment method required; quantity \> 0
fields.**rules**: Payment authorized; ticket issued after webhook confirmation; QR code generated; calendar reminder auto-added

fields.**fields**: title: string (required), description: string, type: select (standard/listening-party/meet-greet), monetization: toggle
fields.**validation**: Title required; type selected; stream key validated
fields.**states**: idle → validating → starting → live (redirects to stream) → error
fields.**rules**: Creator must be verified; 16+ age requirement; content policy check

fields.**purpose**: Validate and submit release for distribution
fields.**props**: releaseId: string, validationResults: ValidationResult[], onSubmit: () =\> void
fields.**fields**: Review required: all validation warnings displayed; confirmAccuracy: toggle (must check \"I confirm all metadata is accurate\")
fields.**actions**: Cancel, Fix Issues, Submit for Distribution
fields.**rules**: All required fields must be valid; audio quality checks pass; metadata validation pass; split percentages sum to 100%

fields.**fields**: legalName: string, artistName: string, taxId: string, documents: file[] (government ID, proof of identity), reason: textarea
fields.**validation**: Required: legalName, artistName, documents; document types: JPEG/PDF, max 10MB
fields.**states**: idle → validating → uploading → submitting → success → error
fields.**rules**: Minimum 10k followers; legal ID must match profile; review queue (1-3 days)

fields.**purpose**: Place hold on payout for review
fields.**props**: payoutId: string, riskScore: number, flags: string[]
fields.**fields**: reason: string (required), holdDuration: select (24h, 7d, 14d, indefinite), reviewerNotes: textarea
fields.**rules**: Risk flags require compliance review; holds trigger notification to recipient; escalated holds go to compliance team
